review: Codex visual collation, 2026-10-19; not expert approval
normalization: Selected definition passages only. Punctuation added; 巳/己 distinguished by branch/stem context. Source order is preserved and does not assign weights. Modern Korean ten-god labels are a separate research terminology choice, not a verbatim ten-label table in this edition.

sections.heading: 論五行相生相尅
sections.text: 金生水，水生木，木生火，火生土，土生金。金尅木，木尅土，土尅水，水尅火，火尅金。
生我者為父母，我生者為子孫，尅我者為官鬼，我尅者為妻財，比和者為兄弟。
sections.usage: Direction definitions only; family/gender claims are not output.

sections.heading: 又論節氣歌
sections.text: 子上十日壬，中旬下旬方是癸。
sections.usage: Seasonal day allocation is distinct from the static hidden-stem list on page 54; not converted to weights.

sections.heading: 又地支藏遁歌
sections.text: 子宮癸水在其中，丑癸辛金己土同。寅宮甲木兼丙戊，卯宮乙木獨相逢。辰藏乙戊三分癸，巳中庚金丙戊叢。午宮丁火並己土，未宮乙己丁共宗。申位庚金壬水戊，酉宮辛金獨豐隆。戌宮辛金及丁戊，亥藏壬甲是真蹤。

sections.heading: 論日為主
sections.text: 取日干為主。甲見庚為殺，陽見陽也；見辛為官，陽見陰也。乙木見庚為官，陰見陽也；見辛為殺。陽見陰為正財，陽見陽為偏財。
甲見癸乙見壬為印綬，甲見壬乙見癸為偏印。甲見丙為食神，乙見丁為食神；甲見丁為傷官，乙見丙為傷官。
以日為主，年為本，月為提綱，時為輔佐。
sections.usage: Keep month branch context, without declaring seasonal strength or favorable elements.

sections.heading: 論偏財
sections.text: 何謂之偏財，蓋陽見陽財陰見陰財也。

sections.heading: 論劫財
sections.text: 甲見乙為敗財，乙見甲為劫財。
sections.usage: This edition distinguishes 敗財 and 劫財 by direction. The research label 겁재 unifies opposite-polarity same-element cases as an explicit unapproved terminology policy. Same-polarity 비견 is also policy-normalized, not attributed to this excerpt. 羊刃 is not treated as a synonym.
